'''''Slader's Raider I''''' was a [[Vee-Kir 4 Bulk Transport]] owned and operated by [[Roark Slader]]. It was modified to allow the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigate]] ''[[Slader's Raider II]]'' to be concealed in the bow.
